397497.title: Language of Selves — Paris Contemporary
397497.overview: A contemporary art exhibition at Gallery CNK in central Daegu, presenting work from the Paris scene. Free. Gallery CNK sits in the Daebong-dong gallery district, walkable from Daegu's downtown.

397501.title: Time of Grass: Open Storage Collection Exhibition
397501.overview: An open-storage exhibition drawn from the Daejeon Museum of Art's own collection — the museum opens part of its storage to the public rather than staging a conventional show, so you see works that normally stay in the vault. Free, in the Dunsan cultural district alongside the city's art and science museums.
